detail.title: 4MP Outdoor Parking Space Detector
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC439-PW1H-Z1050 4MP Outdoor Parking Space Detector Key Points •See better: 4 MP, max. 2688 × 1520@25 fps | 1/1.8" progressive scan CMOS | 0.002 lux low illumination brings clearer nighttime imaging | Captures rate ≥ 95% •High-Intelligence: Supports max. 50 parking spaces detection. Supports multi-monitor modes including area monitoring, parking space monitoring, and plate recognition. •Smart Event Analysis: Supports licensed and unlicensed vehicle recognition, illegal parking & available space detection. •All-Weather Durability: IP67, fully sealed against dust, dirt, and heavy rain. -30°C to 60°C operating temperature suitable for wider outdoor environments •Smart Deployment: 3 Alarm Input & Output, 1Gbps Ethernet, 2 RS-485, 1 RS-232, RCA Audio In/Out for live monitoring. Directly connect barriers, sirens, or access control. H.264/H.265/MJPEG flexible coding. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Basic.Image Resolution: 2688 (H) × 1520 (V) (OSD black background is not calculated in the pixels)
Basic.Bit Rate: H.264M: 32 kbps–32768 kbps H.264H: 32 kbps–32768 kbps H.265: 32 kbps–32768 kbps MJPEG: 512 kbps–65536 kbps
Basic.White Balance: Auto; Natural; Street lamp; Outdoor; Manual; Regional custom
Basic.Exposure Mode: Auto; Manual (select from shutter values or customize shutter range)

Performance.Storage: 1 × built-in TF card slot. The following cards are supported: Kingston 16 GB, 32 GB, 64 GB, and 128 GB; Dahua 16 GB, 32 GB, 64 GB, and 128 GB; SanDisk 16 GB, 32 GB, 64 GB, and 128 GB.
Performance.Image Tampering Prevention: Yes. Verifies watermarks in videos and images
Performance.Alarm Event: Storage full, storage error, no storage card, network disconnection, IP conflict, and illegal access.
Performance.Security: Authorized username and password, MAC address binding, HTTPS encryption, IEEE 802.1x, and network access control
Performance.OSD Overlay: Time, address, device SN, week, space statistics, anti-counterfeiting code, and custom information.

Intelligence.Vehicle Recognition: Supports licensed and unlicensed vehicle recognition.
Intelligence.Counting Mode: Area monitoring, parking space monitoring, and plate recognition mode.
Intelligence.Parking Space Attributes: The attributes of large and small spaces can be configured.

Port.Network: 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet port, 100/1000 M network transmission
Port.Alarm Output: 3 (1 for relay, and 2 for optocoupler), used to link the barrier.
